entry.external_evidence: Not yet in durable storage. Renders and boards were made in the build session and can be regenerated from tools/catalogue_silo_cluster_pilot.
limitations: Fixed native assembly, 94.0 m by 38.8 m including the yard and bay pads; sixteen silos 9.2 m across, 29 m to their cap tips; the head house ridge at 49.5 m. No resizing and no repetition.
Gate A is open: the variant's street view (variant_2.png) is a grey render of the old LEGO model. The model follows the oblique and roof views; a person must accept that or supply a street view.
Heights are proportioned in the oblique; a camera fit was too loose to govern. The roof view leans tall parts north, so plan positions come from the caps and the feet of the shaft and sheds.
The catalogue suggests an 80 by 50 m footprint; the images show a long cluster about 86 by 25 m, and the images govern.
The back row's north side, the ends, the shaft's back and all interiors are inferred; the walkways' stairs are not modelled.
Terrain fit, entrance routing and every runtime gate are untested; see tools/catalogue_silo_cluster_pilot/integration/runtime-review.md.
Independent review: v004 was refused with three P1 (evidence/independent-review-v004.json); v005 answers them and its repeat review is pending.

picker.description: Two rows of concrete grain silos with an elevator tower, a conveyor gallery over the caps and truck bays.
picker.reshape_description: Move and rotate the complete structure. It keeps its authored size.
